title: AArch64 Inductor Perf Test build fails installing torchao
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

We are seeing consistent failures in inductor-perf-nightly-aarch64 since build [658](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/actions/runs/16770088383). 

If we look at the log output we can see

For build 658 👍 
```
Installing dist/ao/torchao-0.7.0+git51c87b6e-py3-none-any.whl
+ python3 -mpip install --no-index --no-deps dist/ao/torchao-0.7.0+git51c87b6e-py3-none-any.whl
Processing ./dist/ao/torchao-0.7.0+git51c87b6e-py3-none-any.whl
Installing collected packages: torchao
  Attempting uninstall: torchao
    Found existing installation: torchao 0.12.0
    Uninstalling torchao-0.12.0:
ERROR: Could not install packages due to an OSError: [Errno 13] Permission denied: 'INSTALLER'
```

but for 657 👎 
```
Installing dist/ao/torchao-0.7.0+git51c87b6e-py3-none-any.whl
+ python3 -mpip install --no-index --no-deps dist/ao/torchao-0.7.0+git51c87b6e-py3-none-any.whl
Processing ./dist/ao/torchao-0.7.0+git51c87b6e-py3-none-any.whl
Installing collected packages: torchao
Successfully installed torchao-0.7.0+git51c87b6e
```

657 doesn't seem to have an existing installation of torchao to uninstall so i've had a look in `.ci/docker` to see what has changed. We can see that the docker image indeed does change between these builds. #159300 seems a likely candidate to have caused this issue. @huydhn 

### Versions

Docker image - 308535385114.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/pytorch/ci-image:pytorch-linux-jammy-aarch64-py3.10-gcc11-inductor-benchmarks-8acc1062692e2b96ed034babdb9ef70d883406a3

Torch - torch-2.9.0a0+gite9d27aa

See failing run here - https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/actions/runs/16824326960

cc @seemethere @malfet @pytorch/pytorch-dev-infra @snadampal @milpuz01 @aditew01 @nikhil-arm @fadara01

error_description: We are seeing consistent failures in inductor-perf-nightly-aarch64 since build 658. The error occurs when trying to install torchao - specifically, there's a permission denied error when trying to uninstall an existing torchao installation. The error message shows: ERROR: Could not install packages due to an OSError: [Errno 13] Permission denied: 'INSTALLER'. The issue mentions that build 657 succeeded because it didn't have an existing installation of torchao to uninstall. The issue suggests that a change in the docker image (PR #159300) may have caused this problem.
